_comment: Second Wind wave (#165) canonical: an already-evolved [Blademaster] at L13, sword_skill_used 33 -- one short of L14's threshold (34) -- levels to 14 ORGANICALLY (the L14 grant is never fixture-banked). The proximity goblin_encounter_1 fight is won by autoplay; the melee AI uses power_strike (weapon:sword) which banks sword_skill_used each use, crossing 34. Sleep at the inn bed then resolves swordsman 13->14, granting [Crescent Cut]. A second real fight (goblin_encounter_2 via goblin_parley) proves crescent_cut actually lands in combat.combatants.pc.skills. Relc fields as ally (met_relc banked) so both fights are winnable against the kiting goblin_shaman; the PC still power_strikes on its own turn, so the sword_skill_used banks are unaffected. Can-fail: blanking swordsman L14's grant makes skill_unlocked{crescent_cut} time out and the pc.skills assert go red.

steps._comment: == FIGHT 1: proximity goblin_encounter_1 (30,23), trigger_radius 2. From (28,20) one step down to (28,21) is Chebyshev 2 -> springs the ambush. Relc fields (met_relc banked in the fixture). The autoplay melee AI uses power_strike (weapon:sword) -> sword_skill_used arrives at 34 from the fixture (GH#211: gray-band fights deposit fractionally at this power gap).
== SLEEP: teleport to the inn bed (inn_upstairs, your_bed 9,1), bump up + interact -> sleep resolves swordsman 13->14, granting [Crescent Cut] organically.

== FIGHT 2: prove [Crescent Cut] actually lands in the live combat kit. Teleport to floodplains (28,16), step down to (28,17) (sets facing DOWN) onto goblin_encounter_2's approach, interact -> goblin_parley -> default 'Draw steel' -> fight. goblin_encounter_1 is spent (one-shot), so column stays clear.
